page.overview:
Who is Maax?

Maax was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Maax was a smuggler based in Carthag who was part of a group led by Stisk that included Valentin, Zoe and Chingo. Valentin poisoned Argus Veer and Maax and Chingo were sent by Stisk to spread the word of his death. They met with the rest of the group afterwards, with Chingo being surprised by how angry the news made the locals. He asked who Veers was, with Maax stating that he had already told him that Veer was the greatest gladiator in 300 years. Maax predicted there would be a full-blown riot within ten minutes.
